'''2017 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Tom Haid DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Haid]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open ISB Haid DS 2017 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014806/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
